summary: Curbline Properties filed an 8-K reporting that the beneficial ownership of director Alexander Otto and his family fell to 7.5% or less of outstanding common stock, triggering an automatic increase in the company's Ownership Limit from 8% to 9.8% for all holders. The related Waiver Agreement with Otto, originally entered into on October 1, 2024 in connection with the spin-off from SITE Centers Corp., terminated automatically, ending the waiver of the Related Party Limit. A Certificate of Notice was filed with Maryland authorities. This is a governance/ownership-structure change, not a traditional special situation. Watch for potential future share accumulation by Otto or other holders now that limits have shifted.
